content:
pat: Heads-up: hit a weird parity bug in the sampleapp rerank flow where metadata gets detached after a retry. Seen on Node + Python helpers.

pat: Repro (Node quicksend):
```js
// quicksend.js
const ids = docs.map((d,i)=>d.id||`doc-${i}`);
const vectors = docs.map(d=>padVec(d.vec, 768));
const meta = docs.map(d=>d.meta||{});
await client.rerank.batch({ model: 'sim-768', body: { ids, vectors, meta } });
```

pat: Symptom: when a shard times out and the runtime retries, the return contains an `ids` array in a different order. The helper then zips scores to original index and reattaches meta by index -> meta ends up on wrong results in UI. Customer saw wrong context snippets.

zayn: Can you paste logs/snippet?

pat: Server log: 
```
[2026-11-02T08:12:34Z] incoming batch id=batch-900 size=10 client=node-0.11.2
[2026-11-02T08:12:34Z] dispatch shard=rerank-7 seq=1201
[2026-11-02T08:12:35Z] model timeout seq=1201
[2026-11-02T08:12:35Z] fallback dispatch shard=rerank-2 seq=1201 retry=1
[2026-11-02T08:12:36Z] response sent seq=1201 idempotency=missing order_preserved=false
```

pat: Response body (trim):
```
{ scores:[0.93,0.74,0.62,0.51,0.43,0.28,0.11,0.07,0.02,0.01], ids:["doc-3","doc-0","doc-7","doc-2","doc-9","doc-1","doc-6","doc-4","doc-5","doc-8"] }
```

kelsey: Two bugs colliding: (A) helper sometimes drops x-idempotency-key on retry due to transport layer refactor; (B) post-process assumes stable ordering and zips meta by index.

kelsey: Also found padVec sanitizer issue: if input shorter it currently fills with `null`/`undefined` which the runtime coerces -> causes inconsistent shard errors and more fallbacks. Repro: a doc with missing dims -> padVec returned array with `null`s.

zayn: Proposed fixes: 1) always attach a per-batch x-idempotency-key (persist across retries); 2) pre-send validation middleware: assert length==model_dim AND all entries finite numbers; throw helpful error listing id + found_len + count_nulls; 3) post-process responses by building id->(score,meta) maps and reattaching by returned ids; only fall back to index mapping if ids missing and emit a warning.

pat: Minimal validator error message example: "invalid_vector: id=doc-17 expected=768 found=760 nulls=8 preview=[0.12,0.13,0.11,...]". This should be surfaced in quickstart dev logs.

kelsey: For DX, update sampleapp quickstart: add one-line comment about idempotency header for production batch workloads and small note about strict vector validation. Keep examples short but add the comment.

qa-bot: Tasks created: DX-7001 (sdk: persist batch idempotency across retries), DX-7002 (helper: strict vector sanitizer + id-based mapping), DX-7003 (parity tests for reordered-id retry across node/python/rust), DX-7004 (sampleapp CI smoke: burst rerank job).

zayn: I'll implement SDK transport change to persist x-idempotency-key and update Node helper to map by ids. Kelsey take python. We'll add unit tests that stub runtime to return reordered ids on retry.

pat: Short-term mitigation: reduce default retries to 1 for rerank/embed helpers and surface a clear quickstart warning. Long-term: make batch retries idempotent by default and server should always return explicit ids array for batches.

kelsey: PR drafts: node-sdk https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/1741 (draft), python-sdk https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/621 (draft). Assigning reviewers.

devex-bot: Reminder: 1) include unit tests that validate meta alignment after retry; 2) add small CI smoke test (50 bursts) to sampleapp; 3) update docs/quickstart comment.

pat: Thanks team, filing customer follow-up now. This explains the wrong-snippets bug we saw on the dashboard earlier. :relieved:
